seller.intro: Are you a property owner in Turin and want to sell it quickly? Jungle Rent is the direct buyer you were looking for. We purchase apartments in Turin's university areas (Crocetta, San Salvario, Centro, Vanchiglia, Vanchiglietta, Aurora, Lingotto) to transform them into optimized housing solutions for students and young professionals.
seller.whyWeAcquire: Why we acquire properties in Turin
seller.para1: Jungle Rent was born from the vision of optimizing the student rental market in Turin, a continuously growing university city with over 90,000 students between Politecnico di Torino, University of Turin (UniTo), ESCP Business School and IED. The demand for quality accommodation in university areas is very high, but the supply is often fragmented and unprofessional.
seller.para2: Our mission is to acquire strategically positioned apartments in university areas and transform them into modern and optimized housing: comfortable shared spaces, well-furnished single rooms, included services and professional management. For this reason we are looking for three-room, four-room and larger apartments in areas such as
seller.zones: Crocetta, San Salvario, Centro, Vanchiglia, Vanchiglietta, Aurora, Lingotto, Santa Rita and San Paolo
seller.para3: ideally 10-20 minutes walk or public transport from Turin's main universities.
seller.para4: We work with specialized notaries and lawyers to guarantee safe and fast transactions. Our valuation is based on weekly updated market analysis, considering location, size, property condition and optimization potential for the rental market.
seller.advantagesTitle: Advantages of selling to Jungle Rent:
seller.para5: no agency commission (save €6,000-10,000), quick process without dozens of visits from strangers at home, clear written offer within 48 hours of inspection, included legal support and secure payment.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to your questions
faq.investorQ1: What is the minimum investment required?
faq.investorA1: The minimum investment in Jungle Rent starts from €100, allowing access to the Turin real estate market even with limited capital. For those wanting to invest more, opportunities depend on the properties we have available and that we want to acquire.
faq.investorA2: You invest in Jungle Rent for a specific apartment that we select and acquire. You know exactly which property your capital goes into. We handle everything: tenants, contracts, maintenance. That apartment's results generate your returns. WARNING: investments involve risks, including possible partial or total loss of invested capital.
faq.investorQ3: Does Jungle Rent manage the property completely?
faq.investorA3: Yes, we offer a full-service management service that includes: tenant search and selection, contract management and registrations, ordinary and extraordinary maintenance, rent collection, arrears management, legal assistance, and detailed bi-monthly reporting. The investor participates in results without having to worry about anything.
faq.investorQ4: How long does it take to see the first results?
faq.investorA4: The first results are communicated after approximately 2 months from investment, once the setup phase is completed (purchase/renovation, tenant search, contract registration). Subsequently, you receive detailed bi-monthly reports.
faq.investorQ5: What type of contracts are offered to tenants?
faq.investorA5: We use temporary contracts with study motivation (art. 5 L. 431/98) aligned with the academic year, renewable annually. This type guarantees greater rotation (therefore rent adjustment to market rates) and legal protection for both owner and tenant.
faq.investorA6: Once you've made your investment, we take care of everything: tenant selection, contracts, maintenance and rent collection. You receive detailed bi-monthly reports with all portfolio data.
faq.investorQ7: What reports do I receive and how often?
faq.investorA7: You receive a detailed bi-monthly report that includes: property status, occupancy rate, portfolio results, expenses incurred and forecasts for the next period. You also have access to an online dashboard to monitor your investment in real-time.
faq.investorQ8: Can I visit the properties before investing?
faq.investorA8: Yes, we organize property visits by appointment for interested investors. You can see the properties in person, evaluate the quality of the renovations and speak directly with our management team.
faq.investorQ9: How can I invest with Jungle Rent?
faq.investorA9: You can invest in Jungle Rent from €100 for a specific apartment. Not an anonymous fund: you know which property you are financing. Jungle Rent acquires, manages and distributes the returns.
faq.investorA10: Results are calculated based on our hybrid model: renting to university students during the academic year and short-term tourist rentals in summer months. This model optimizes occupancy compared to traditional fixed-rent contracts. Results are net of management costs but gross of personal taxes. WARNING: results depend on market performance and are not guaranteed. Investments involve risks, including possible partial or total loss of capital.
faq.investorQ11: What is the hybrid student/tourist model?
faq.investorA11: Our hybrid model combines: (1) Rentals to university students with transitional contracts aligned with the academic year, ensuring stability and reliable tenants; (2) Short-term tourist rentals in summer months when students are on vacation, maximizing seasonal revenue. Students save significantly compared to traditional contracts, paying only for the months they actually stay. Additionally, we offer free guest days during summer so students can return to Turin for exams at no extra cost.
faq.studentQ1: How does the flexible contract work?
faq.studentA1: The transitional study contract covers the academic year (September-June), allowing you to pay only for the months you're actually in Turin. You save significantly compared to traditional contracts. The contract is renewable annually.
faq.studentQ2: What if I need to come back to Turin for summer exams?
faq.studentA2: We offer free guest days during summer months. This means you can return to Turin for summer session exams without paying additional rent. It's included in your contract.
faq.studentQ3: How much do I save compared to traditional rent?
faq.studentA3: With our model, you save significantly compared to a traditional 12-month contract. You only pay for the academic year months, avoiding summer rent when you're not in Turin.
faq.studentQ4: In which areas of Turin do you have housing?
faq.studentA4: Our accommodations are in the most sought-after university areas: San Salvario, Crocetta, Vanchiglia, Centro, Aurora, Cenisia. All within minutes walking or cycling from Politecnico, UniTo and other Turin universities.
faq.studentA5: Rent includes: furnished room, condo fees, Wi-Fi, weekly common area cleaning, ordinary maintenance. Utilities (electricity, gas, water) are separate and shared among roommates. Registered legal contracts and dedicated support.
faq.sellerA1: We buy apartments in Turin and surrounding areas, preferably in university zones: Vanchiglia, San Salvario, Cenisia, Crocetta, Lingotto, Aurora. We're interested in properties with 2 to 5 rooms, even those needing renovation. We evaluate every proposal without obligation.
faq.sellerQ2: How does the free valuation work?
faq.sellerA2: Fill out the form with the property details and we'll contact you within 24 hours. After an initial phone analysis, we arrange a free visit to evaluate the property. We provide a market estimate and, if interested, a purchase offer within 7 days.
faq.sellerQ3: How long does it take to sell?
faq.sellerA3: Our process is much faster than traditional sales. From valuation to notary deed can take 30-60 days, depending on the complexity of the paperwork and property availability. We handle all the bureaucracy.
faq.sellerQ4: Do I need to renovate before selling?
faq.sellerA4: No, we buy properties in any condition, even those needing complete renovation. In fact, we often prefer properties that need work because we can adapt them to student needs. The purchase price will reflect the property's condition.
faq.sellerA5: Payment is made at the notary deed via bank transfer or certified check. We can be flexible on handover timing if you need time to relocate. There are no commissions or hidden costs for the seller.
faq.sellerQ6: What's the difference between you and a real estate agency?
faq.sellerA6: The fundamental difference is that we are the direct buyer, not an intermediary. An agency finds a buyer for you (and charges you a 3-4% commission). We instead buy your property directly for our portfolio, eliminating intermediaries, commissions and dozens of visits.
faq.sellerA7: Because we're not intermediaries. Agencies charge commissions because they connect sellers and buyers. We instead buy directly to transform properties into student housing, so there's no intermediary to pay. You save €6,000-10,000.
faq.aboutQ1: Who are you and how long have you been operating?
faq.aboutA1: Jungle Rent S.r.l. is an innovative startup founded in October 2025 by Lorenzo Oni-Joseph and Andrea Niccolaini. We have been operating with our own investments for 2 years, and starting from February 2026 we will launch the startup to open investment opportunities to external investors as well. We are incubated by 2i3T, the Politecnico di Torino incubator.
faq.aboutA2: You can contact us on WhatsApp at +39 331 905 3037 (response within 2 hours), email junglerententeprise@gmail.com, or by filling out the forms on the site. Office: via Gioacchino Quarello 15/A, Turin. Available for meetings by appointment.
faq.aboutQ3: Are you a real estate agency?
faq.aboutA3: No. Jungle Rent is a real estate startup with a dual mission: to solve the student housing crisis and democratize access to real estate — a historically safe asset class that, unlike in the past, has become inaccessible to many. We acquire, renovate and manage properties to rent to university students and tourists.
faq.voiceQ1: How can I invest in real estate in Turin with little money?
faq.voiceA1: With Jungle Rent you invest in a specific apartment that we select in Turin's university areas. From just €100, you know exactly where your capital goes — we handle the rest.
faq.voiceQ2: Is it safe to invest in Jungle Rent?
faq.voiceA2: Jungle Rent is a certified innovative startup, registered with the Turin Chamber of Commerce with VAT number 13333450016. We are incubated by 2i3T, the University of Turin incubator. However, like any investment, it carries risks including possible loss of capital.
faq.voiceQ3: How much can you earn investing in student apartments in Turin?
faq.voiceA3: Results depend on market performance and are not guaranteed. Our hybrid student/tourist model optimizes occupancy: student rentals during the academic year and tourist rentals in summer months. You receive detailed bi-monthly reports.
faq.voiceQ4: How can I see my real estate returns?
faq.voiceA4: You have access to a personal online dashboard where you can monitor your investment in real-time. Additionally, you receive a detailed bi-monthly report via email with property status, occupancy rate, results and forecasts.
faq.voiceQ5: How can I sell my house quickly in Turin?
faq.voiceA5: Jungle Rent buys your house directly without intermediaries. Fill out the form, receive a free valuation within 48 hours, inspection within 7 days, written offer within 48 hours of inspection, and closing in 60-90 days. Zero commissions.
faq.voiceQ6: Who buys apartments near Politecnico di Torino?
faq.voiceA6: Jungle Rent buys apartments in Turin's university areas: Crocetta, San Salvario, Centro, Vanchiglia, Aurora, Lingotto, very close to Politecnico and UniTo. We buy three-room, four-room and larger apartments, even those needing renovation.
faq.voiceQ7: How much is my apartment in San Salvario worth?
faq.voiceA7: The value depends on size, floor, condition and exact location in San Salvario. A typical three-room apartment (80-90 sqm) in good condition is valued at approximately €180,000-220,000. Request a free valuation from Jungle Rent for a precise price.
faq.voiceQ8: Where do university students live in Turin?
faq.voiceA8: University students in Turin prefer neighborhoods near universities: San Salvario and Crocetta for Politecnico, Centro and Vanchiglia for UniTo, Aurora for affordable prices. These areas offer services, nightlife and transportation.
faq.voiceQ9: What is the best area for students near Politecnico?
faq.voiceA9: The best areas for students near Politecnico di Torino are Crocetta (elegant, quiet, 5-10 minute walk), San Salvario (lively, multicultural, affordable) and Cenisia/San Paolo (quieter, great prices).
faq.voiceQ10: How does the student rental market work in Turin?
faq.voiceA10: Turin has over 90,000 university students and high demand for housing. Contracts are typically aligned with the academic year, prices range from €300-600 for a single room depending on the area. Jungle Rent offers flexible contracts with significant savings.
faq.voiceQ11: How much does it cost to rent a room in Turin for students?
faq.voiceA11: A single room for students in Turin costs on average €350-500 per month in areas like San Salvario, €400-550 in Crocetta, €300-400 in Aurora. Prices include condo fees but not utilities.
faq.voiceQ12: Is Jungle Rent reliable for investing?
faq.voiceA12: Jungle Rent is a limited liability company registered in Italy (VAT 13333450016, REA TO-1355899), certified as an innovative startup. We are incubated by 2i3T, partner of Politecnico di Torino. We offer transparent contracts and bi-monthly reports.
faq.voiceQ13: What happens if I want to exit my Jungle Rent investment?
faq.voiceA13: Exit conditions are defined in the contract. We recommend contacting us to discuss available options. The investment is designed for medium to long-term horizons (3-5 years) to maximize results.
faq.voiceQ14: Does Jungle Rent buy houses that need renovation?
faq.voiceA14: Yes, Jungle Rent also buys apartments that need renovation in Turin's university areas, but we evaluate case by case based on the complexity of the required work and the location. For properties in good condition or needing partial work, we buy directly. The price always reflects the property's condition.
faq.voiceQ15: How do I contact Jungle Rent to invest?
faq.voiceA15: You can contact Jungle Rent on WhatsApp at +39 331 905 3037 (response within 2 hours), email junglerententeprise@gmail.com, or by filling out the form on junglerent.it. Lorenzo Oni-Joseph, the founder, will personally respond to you.
